_about: Camera angles for the twin-speaker screen room (void-pair). Framed with frame_check.py so the cones sit on the thirds lines, one cone per crossing or box where possible (Robert, 2026-11-12); viewpoints are the ones he picked, cameras level, reframed with lens shift. multicam.mjs renders them side by side, in this order. 'cones' approved by Robert as perfect. Check the picture too: numbers alone let a too-side-on view through once.

angles.name: three-quarter
angles._framing: three-quarter: near speaker large and sharp with its woofers on the right third line (lower one on the crossing), wide aperture so the far speaker and screen go soft behind it

angles.name: cones
angles._framing: the two woofers on the left third line at its upper and lower crossings, mid and tweeter on the right third

angles.name: close-low
angles._framing: his original close low viewpoint, aimed (no lens shift: a big shift went soft off-axis): the two woofers on the left third crossings, tweeter by the upper-right crossing, mid in the centre box
